mainText: Hello, Verona! At 5 PM, here is today's balanced dish. It is a pleasant 60 degrees at Verona Community Park under a Waxing Gibbous moon. The ISS will be visible starting at 5:49 PM, rising in the northwest near Verona High School and traveling toward the northeast near Home Depot. Expect an overnight low of 47 degrees with rain in the forecast.

City Hall reminds everyone that offices will be closed November 26 and 27 for Thanksgiving. Additionally, the City is planning a major expansion of the Public Works and Utilities facility to keep up with our growing population, and construction continues on Mark Drive, Legion Street, and other local infrastructure projects.

We have a full lineup of entertainment this weekend. Catch live music at Bailey's Run and Paddy Mac's today, plus more music at Wisconsin Brewing Company tomorrow. Looking ahead, you can enjoy yoga at Insight Wellness on Sunday or trivia nights starting Tuesday at various local spots.
In our weekly police report, on November 4, officers responded to a two-vehicle crash in a business parking lot on East Verona Avenue where a driver was arrested for O W I with a minor in the car.
Today's delicious flavor of the day is Crazy for Cookie Dough. Culver's is currently open and serving until 10:30 PM tonight, so there is still plenty of time to stop by and enjoy a treat.
